maps.name: The Island
maps.purchase: Included in ARK: Survival Ascended; No need to buy extra DLC.
maps.summary: Starting point: from the beach, taming and building a base to the artifact cave, guardian and Tek Cave.
maps.storyRole: The opening chapter of the Survivor route; Explore the nature of the ARK before ascension.
goals: Build a base near water and metal lines.
Collect artifacts and tributes at the right difficulty level.
Prepare the breeding team, saddle and supplies for the guardian then Tek Cave.
preparation: Separate the team to go to the cave and the team to fight the boss.
Bring cold-proof gear, SCUBA for sea routes and spare gear.
Practice whistles, formations and time to enter Tek Cave before the main turn.

maps.name: Scorched Earth
maps.purchase: Included in ARK: Survival Ascended; No need to buy extra DLC.
maps.summary: The desert is harsh with thirst, heat, storms and Wyvern.
maps.storyRole: The next chapter after The Island in the ascension roadmap.
goals: Establish water and shelter before exploring far.
Preparing for the egg retrieval trip Wyvern.
Collect artifacts and tributes to challenge Manticore.
preparation: Prioritize insulation, water reserves and Adobe houses.
Keep the mount with a spare set of clothes when trenching.
Storm shelter; Avoid being completely dependent on electrical equipment.

maps.name: Aberration
maps.purchase: Included in ARK: Survival Ascended; No need to buy extra DLC.
maps.summary: ARK fails with multi-level cave system, radiation, Nameless and glowing creatures.
maps.storyRole: Discover the secrets of ARK and confront Rockwell after Scorched Earth.
goals: Tame the light pet and stabilize the base to a safe level.
Open resource, gas and charge routes.
Prepare the anti-radiation kit to retrieve eggs Rock Drake and go deep.
preparation: Light pet needs enough charge to resist Nameless.
Wear multiple Hazmat suits because losing one piece can cause loss of protection.
Climbing picks, ziplines and drawlines are more important than flyers.

maps.name: Extinction
maps.purchase: Included in ARK: Survival Ascended; No need to buy extra DLC.
maps.summary: Return to Earth infected with Element: abandoned city, OSD and giant Titans.
maps.storyRole: Complete the ARK cycle on Earth; forward to Lost Colony and Genesis.
goals: Set up a safe base and farm resources before entering the wasteland.
Train OSD and Element Vein from the appropriate level.
Prepare tribute, Titan and lineup for King Titan.
preparation: Observe meteors and creatures Corrupted.
Carry repair supplies, ammo stores and spare mounts for a long battle.
Do not play high-end OSD with an untried team.

maps.name: Lost Colony
maps.purchase: Need to own ARK: Survival Ascended and purchase Lost Colony Expansion Pass.
maps.summary: Arat Prime in the icy night: gothic city, Red Element, Thrall and new skill system.
maps.storyRole: A new ASA chapter about Arat Prime that connects Extinction to ARK 2. Its flashbacks and timing need separate interpretation; read it after the Genesis story, without assuming every event falls between Extinction and Genesis.
goals: Open the cold-resistant base and learn skillpaths.
Recruit and equip Thrall for logistical and combat support.
Clear outposts for Sigils, prepare the Red-Handed mission in Red Palace, and face Lost King/Lost Queen in two fights.
preparation: Prepare Arctic Armor, healing supplies, and spare gear.
Choose the Wayfarer, Beastmaster, or Utility skill according to the target.
Try the outpost route before carrying all your valuables.

maps.name: Genesis Part 1
maps.purchase: Included in ARK: Survival Ascended; No need to buy extra DLC.
maps.summary: Simulate multiple biomes with HLN-A, mission, Hexagon and expanded ocean in ASA.
maps.storyRole: Test stage of Genesis after Earth; leading to the story Seed Ship.
goals: Complete missions at the appropriate difficulty level and fix glitches.
Use Hexagon to support supplies, learn each biome before increasing the difficulty.
Prepare mission goals for the end-of-chapter progress.
preparation: Change items according to biome: cold, lava, deep water and low gravity.
Practice missions before upgrading to Beta or Alpha.
Tides of Fortune adds ships and naval combat; Not required to enter the map.

maps.name: Genesis Part 2
maps.purchase: Access to the released version of ASA has not been confirmed; Check the official announcement before buying.
maps.summary: Next chapter on Seed Ship; Version ASA was not confirmed to have been released during this test.
maps.storyRole: Following Genesis Part 1 in the story roadmap.
goals: Watch for the release announcement of ASA before creating a new save.
preparation: Do not use the Survival Evolved content or schedule to claim that ASA is available.

maps.name: The Center
maps.purchase: Included in ARK: Survival Ascended; No need to buy extra DLC.
maps.summary: Floating islands, giant waterfalls, an underground world, and ocean caves make this an exploration-focused map.
maps.storyRole: Free secondary map; You can play between story chapters.
goals: Open floating islands, underworld and sea caves.
Prepare artifact and guardian arena.
Choose based on flight or sea route instead of just straight distance.
preparation: Bring spare cold-weather gear, heat protection, and SCUBA.
Prepare to mount the sign in front of the underwater artifact route.
Vertical terrain and lava require safe respawn points.

maps.name: Ragnarok
maps.purchase: Included in ARK: Survival Ascended; No need to buy extra DLC.
maps.summary: Wide map with forests, deserts, ice, dungeons and Wyvern; ASA adds island and Bison.
maps.storyRole: Exploration and construction secondary map; No need to follow the story line.
goals: Open artifact, dungeon, and resource routes.
Prepare a flying mount before collecting Wyvern eggs.
Explore the new ASA island; Complete the artifact to challenge Nunatak Gamma → Beta → Alpha.
preparation: Use anti-cold gear for ice areas, SCUBA for the sea.
Bring medicine, ammunition, and spare gear for dungeons.
Keep an eye on volcano and hot spring when choosing a farm route.
ASA uses Nunatak in place of Ragnarok Evolved's Dragon + Manticore; do not assume ASE tributes or team compositions apply.

maps.name: Valguero
maps.purchase: Included in ARK: Survival Ascended; No need to buy extra DLC.
maps.summary: White Cliffs, tundra, Redwoods and Aberration Trench; ASA has Rock Drake, Reaper and Megaraptor.
maps.storyRole: A side map with its own exploration journey; not a required canon chapter.
goals: Learn the White Cliffs terrain and Deinonychus egg routes.
Prepare a trench expedition for eggs and Reapers.
Explore caves; prepare artifacts and tributes for Grendel at Forsaken Oasis.
bosses: Grendel · ASA guardian, a Megaraptor variant
Broodmother Lysrix · boss outside the arena
preparation: Bring cold protection for the tundra; prepare gear and a light pet before entering the trench.
Place beds and spare gear outside dangerous areas.
ASA features Grendel; do not use Valguero Evolved's Dragon + Manticore + Megapithecus arena.

maps.name: Astraeos
maps.purchase: Requires ARK: Survival Ascended and the Astraeos DLC.
maps.summary: A Greek mythology world now at 1.0: rough seas, deserts, floating islands, and underwater cities.
maps.storyRole: A side map with its own ascension; it does not replace the main story chapters.
goals: Open artifact cave routes at Pyranthos and the labyrinth.
Practice navigating rough seas with Trireme and ocean mounts.
Progress from minibosses to Hydraskos and two Kraken challenges.
preparation: Bring cold/heat protection for each region and SCUBA for the abyss.
Prepare a coordinated team for multi-headed bosses and sea battles.
Tides of Fortune is an optional addition; the map requires Astraeos DLC.

maps.name: Dragontopia
maps.purchase: Requires ARK: Survival Ascended and the Dragontopia DLC.
maps.summary: The DLC is on sale with dragons/skills; Steam schedules the full skyworld map for 12/2026.
maps.storyRole: A fantasy side branch; the complete map is not yet confirmed playable.
signatureCreatures: Eclipsar Umbra · included in the DLC
goals: Experience the dragons currently available on supported maps.
Wait for the skyworld launch announcement before transferring map progression.
preparation: Check which content is available; do not treat the DLC sale date as the release of the full map.
Sky-behemoth content in month 10 and skyworld in month 12 are planned releases.

dlcs.name: Bob's Tall Tales
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: Three side chapters: Frontier on Scorched Earth (Oasisaur, train), Steampunk on Aberration (Cosmo, robot, gene trait), and Wasteland on Extinction (BattleRig). They are not required to play these maps.

dlcs.name: Astraeos
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: A Greek 1.0 map with Heaven & Abyss, Trireme, mythological bosses, and ascension.

dlcs.name: Lost Colony
dlcs.purchase: Access requires Lost Colony Expansion Pass; check ownership before buying again.
dlcs.summary: The canon Arat Prime chapter; map access is included in Lost Colony Expansion Pass.

dlcs.name: Lost Colony Expansion Pass
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: Includes Lost Colony, Drakelings, and Elderclaw; the Lost Colony soundtrack is listed as included with the pass.

dlcs.name: Fantastic Tames · Pyromane
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: A shoulder cat that transforms into a rideable lion; supports fire, cooking meat, and forge fuel. Purchase grants taming access, not a map.

dlcs.name: Fantastic Tames · Dreadmare
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: A dark mount that can move and store creatures using shadow powers; purchase grants taming access, not a map.

dlcs.name: Fantastic Tames · Drakelings
dlcs.purchase: Available separately or included in lost-colony-pass. Requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: Four seasonal shoulder dragons that support healing, resistance, harvesting, and damage reduction. Not a map.

dlcs.name: Fantastic Tames · Elderclaw
dlcs.purchase: Available separately or included in lost-colony-pass. Requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: A forest guardian that uses roots, totems, and Spirit Echo to protect allies. Not a map.

dlcs.name: Fantastic Tames Season 1
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: Burrowbuck and Cerberax are available; Enigmasaur is planned for Q4/2026. Pyromane, Dreadmare, Drakelings, and Elderclaw are not included merely because they share the Fantastic Tames name.

dlcs.name: Tides of Fortune
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: Adds Sloop/Brigantine/Galleon, naval combat, treasure, Tidepup, and Parrot. Genesis Part 1 is playable free with the base game; this pack is optional.

dlcs.name: Dragontopia
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: The DLC currently includes dragons and a skill tree; the map-wide skyworld is scheduled for 12/2026. A DLC being on sale does not mean the complete map has launched.

dlcs.name: Animated Series 109-Costumes Pack
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: Character and creature outfits based on ARK Animated Series; does not unlock maps, bosses, or story chapters.

dlcs.name: Lost Colony Original Soundtrack
dlcs.purchase: Included with Lost Colony Expansion Pass; this is additional music, not gameplay access.
dlcs.summary: Music by Gareth Coker; Steam lists the soundtrack as included with Lost Colony Expansion Pass. Does not unlock gameplay.

dlcs.name: Power Rangers · Wave 1
dlcs.purchase: Separate purchase; requires ARK: Survival Ascended.
dlcs.summary: A Power Rangers collaboration skin pack through the marketplace/mod browser. Non-buyers can still see the skins; it does not unlock stories or maps.
